mission.title: Your Info or Your RSI
mission.description: Lead a squad of commandos into gang territory and recover the documents they carry.

npc.say: Good work. We'll have these scanned and analyzed ASAP.
Those guys must have been pretty new to the City to fall for that old trick!

phase.briefing:
Warrior, as you have probably already heard, a new Exile group has appeared in the City: camouflaged commandos who come and go in military helicopters. While they have yet to make an overtly hostile move against Zion, we have no hard data as to their motives. Commander Lock has decided that, at this turbulent time, we must consider this armed faction to be an enemy until proven otherwise.
Our scouts spotted three of these commandos in a rooftop meeting with others who arrived by helicopter. This small group has now entered the vacant floor of a nearby building. We want you to meet with them, tell them that you represent a powerful group in the City, and get them to follow you outside. I will give you further orders at that time.

enter.say: The commandos should be in there.
Zion thinks it's unlikely that they'll shoot on sight--I guess we're the acid test. Fun, huh?

talk.say: Very well, we will accompany you. We seek to establish friendly relations with all groups in the City.

done.say: All right. Let's get them out on the street.

objective.text: Lead Kang, Barrows and Vandenberg out of the area

phase.briefing:
Warrior, intel believes that one of those commandos is carrying valuable documents received from their superiors. The contents of the documents likely shed light on the aims of the commando group. We want you to obtain these documents.
Normally, I would have you dispose of the commando programs yourself. However, because we do not want to alarm their faction, we must not appear to attack them unprovoked. Therefore, you will lead the three into a dangerous neighborhood of the City and allow the local gangs to terminate them. It should look like an unfortunate mugging or accident. Just make sure to recover the documents and deliver them to our intel contact, Castafiore.

done.say: I'm scanning something on Kang's body.

objective.text: Get the documents from Kang's body

phase.briefing: Those look like the documents intel wanted. Take them to Castafiore at the indicated location.

enter.say: Castafiore is waiting for the documents in there.

mission.finish: Well done, {player}. The documents you recovered contained a coded list of coordinate sets, pointing to rooftop locations throughout the city. Our analysts think that these may be landing points for commando helicopters. Commander Lock has ordered increased surveillance of the indicated sites.
